name: Infinite Guard doubles the applied Temporal Restoration and Temporal Swiftness auras (#11117, #10878)
contract: Infinite Guard 574312 reads "Increases the effectiveness of your Temporal Resilience, Temporal Swiftness, and Temporal Restoration spells by $s1%"; Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), +100%, on EffectSpellClassMask [0,0,0x04000000], which Temporal Restoration 680456 and Temporal Swiftness 680390 carry in SpellFamilyFlags[2] of SpellFamilyName 28. Spell.dbc authors Temporal Restoration Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_MOD_MANA_REGEN_FROM_STAT 25 (Spirit) and Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_MOD_MANA_REGEN_INTERRUPT 25, Temporal Swiftness Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT 10 (Spirit) and Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL -25. Player::UpdateManaRegen reads the live aura amounts, so the value the server applies is the amount of the aura on the caster. A buff cast without the talent carries 25/25 and 10/-25; the same buff cast with the talent carries 50/50 and 20/-50.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Untalented, the Temporal Restoration aura gives 25% of Spirit as regen
Untalented, the Temporal Restoration aura keeps 25% of regen in combat
Untalented, the Temporal Swiftness aura gives 10% of Spirit as haste
Untalented, the Temporal Swiftness aura cuts magic duration by 25%
With Infinite Guard, the Temporal Restoration aura gives 50% of Spirit as regen
With Infinite Guard, the Temporal Restoration aura keeps 50% of regen in combat
With Infinite Guard, the Temporal Swiftness aura gives 20% of Spirit as haste
With Infinite Guard, the Temporal Swiftness aura cuts magic duration by 50%
